venice-ai-media 1.0.0

- Initial release with support for image generation, upscaling, and AI editing via Venice AI.
- Enables image-to-video creation using both WAN and Sora models.
- Includes scripts for setup, API key configuration, and media output handling.
- Provides detailed quick start, usage flags, pricing overview, and troubleshooting guidance.
Initial release - image generation, upscaling, AI editing, and video (WAN/Sora/Runway/Kling/Veo)
